title: Microsoft Teams: new sharing panel in meetings
summary: The roadmap details, announced rollout windows, default state and PowerShell command are supported. The briefing should not suggest that screen-sharing meeting policies may not apply to the redesigned panel: Microsoft's documented scope already covers desktop and window sharing in Teams meetings. The licensing model also understates the published Teams licensing requirement.
